Governance

Board governance

Both boards operate under a shared conflict-of-interest policy. Board members complete an annual conflict-of-interest disclosure; the forms for each entity are collected by staff at the start of every board year.

Pending content migration: the annual conflict-of-interest disclosure forms (Education Fund and Equality Ohio) will be linked here. Until then, they remain on the current site at equalityohio.org/conflict-of-interest-forms.

Ohio’s statewide LGBTQ+ advocacy and legal aid organization — working toward an Ohio where justice, dignity, and self-determination belong to everyone.
